transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Uh... yeah. Just had a work physical. The doctor there said my weight is too low, so they sent me here. I don't really see it as an issue, to be honest. I just feel... I don't know, lighter on my feet for basketball. And I'm not as weighed down when I'm working at the garage. But... yeah. That's what they said.
Have you been trying to lose weight or eating less than usual on purpose?

I wouldn't really say I'm trying to lose weight. I just... I keep things pretty simple. 

Most days I just stick to coffee in the morning. Then maybe a small sandwich later on, or... I don't know, just half of whatever is around. The shop usually runs late, and things are always busy at the house, so... it's just easier. I feel better just sticking to my own simple rules.
Do you ever feel afraid of gaining weight or find yourself avoiding eating even when you're hungry?

I don't know if I'd say afraid. I just... I don't like it. 

If I see the scale bump up even a pound, or... if my jeans start feeling tighter, I just start thinking I'm getting soft. I don't want that. I need to be able to move quick around the cars at the shop, or... you know, up and down the court. If I put on weight, I'll just get slower. So... yeah. I guess I just try to avoid that.
Do you push yourself to exercise more or harder if you feel like you've eaten too much or if you're worried about gaining weight?
No, not really. I just... I play my regular games. And I'm on my feet at the shop all day anyway, so... I don't really go out of my way to do extra stuff. I just stick to my normal routine.
Do you ever make yourself sick or do anything to get rid of food after you eat, especially if you're worried about gaining weight?
No. I... no, I don't do anything like that. Never made myself sick or... whatever. I just don't do that.
Can you tell me about your eating habits over the past week and if you’ve noticed your weight dropping below what’s healthy for your height?

I don't really keep track of the weight part. I don't know if it's below what's healthy. It's just... what it is. 

This past week... I don't know, it's just been normal. I usually just have coffee in the morning. Maybe a small sandwich later, or... half of whatever someone brings to the shop. The shop gets busy, and then things are busy at home, so... it's just easier to stick to my own rules. Keeps things simple. I just feel better doing it that way.
Do you see yourself as thinner than others say you are, or do you feel like you need to lose more weight even if others say you're already too thin?
I don't really pay attention to what other people say about it. I just... I look like me. I don't know about needing to lose more or whatever. I'm just fine how I am.
Have you had any medical illnesses or symptoms like changes in digestion, fatigue, or unexplained weight loss even before you started thinking about your weight?
No, nothing like that. I haven't really been sick. Just... normal tired from work, I guess. Nothing unusual.
Do you place a lot of importance on your weight or shape in how you judge yourself, like feeling that how you look determines your worth or how you feel about yourself?

I don't... I don't really think about it like that. My worth? No. I just... I go to work, fix cars, come home. It's not about judging myself or whatever. I just like to keep things a certain way, that's all. I don't really sit around thinking about my shape.
Have you noticed any problems with your daily life—like at work, with friends, or at home—because of how you eat or think about food?

Not really at work. I'm keeping up with everything at the garage just fine... still playing in my basketball league, too. So, no problems there. 

At home... I guess there's a little tension. I just... I avoid sitting down for the regular family meals. Now everybody keeps asking if I'm okay. It's... I don't know. It's fine, really. Just people asking too many questions.
Do you ever feel like you're overweight, even when others tell you that you're too thin or not heavy enough for your height?
No, I don't think I'm overweight. I mean, I know I'm not. I just... I like being lean for basketball. It's not about feeling fat or anything.
Do you ever feel that your eating habits or weight are out of your control, or do you wish you could eat more normally but can't seem to do so?
No, I... I have it under control. I eat what I need to. I don't really think about wishing it was different. It's just how I do things.
Do you ever feel like your body is too big or that certain parts of you are too large, even if others say you're too thin?
No, not really. I mean... I'm just trying to stay in shape. I don't sit around analyzing every part of my body. It's just about being fit for the court, that's all.
Do you ever look in the mirror and feel like your body looks different than it actually is, like you see yourself as larger even if you're not?
No. I just see what's there. I'm not... imagining things. I just look in the mirror and see myself.
Have you ever had episodes where you feel like you're eating a very large amount of food in a short period of time and feel like you can't stop yourself, even if you wanted to?
No. I don't do that. I just... I eat my meals and that's it. Never really had that problem.
Can you tell me approximately how much weight you’ve lost over what time period, and whether you’ve noticed your weight being significantly lower than what is considered normal for your height?

I don't know the exact amount. The doctor at my work physical is the one who brought it up... said my weight was too low. But honestly, I just feel lighter on my feet when I play basketball. And it's easier moving around the garage, not feeling so weighed down. So, I don't know what's considered normal.
Have you ever noticed your clothes becoming looser or other signs that you might be losing weight, even if you weren't trying to?
I mean... I guess some of my work shirts fit a little looser. But they're old, they stretch out. I just cinch my belt a little tighter. It's not a big deal.
Have you noticed any other changes in your body lately, like feeling weaker, having less energy, or any new aches and pains that don't go away?
No, not really. I mean... I still work my shifts just fine. My energy is okay. Just normal soreness from being under cars all day, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary.
